title: One body became three flying bodies
era: 1994 Old School illustrated with modern upkeep rules
matchup: Workshop Prison against ground-heavy red-green creatures
story: At the beginning of my upkeep, Tetravus still had all three +1/+1 counters and was a 4/4 flyer. I chose to remove two counters, creating two 1/1 flying Tetravite artifact creature tokens. Tetravus was now a 2/2 flyer, and I had three bodies instead of one. My opponent's Kird Ape and Juggernaut were formidable on the ground, but neither could block a flyer without help. I could not sacrifice the tokens whenever I wished to recharge Tetravus; its separate upkeep ability would let me exile its own tokens to replace counters.
review: Tetravus base 1/1 plus three counters starts 4/4. Remove two at beginning of upkeep creates 2 flying 1/1 Tetravite tokens and leaves 2/2. Its OTHER upkeep trigger may exile, not sacrifice, tokens created by this same Tetravus to restore counters. Both triggers may be ordered. Ground attackers cannot block flyers.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
